ws.skill.creationPrompt: I want to create a reusable Hara skill. Ask no more than four short questions to understand the scenario, when it should trigger, the steps or constraints, and where it should be saved (personal or project). After I answer, show a preview with name, description, instructions, and scope. Do not write any file yet. Only after I explicitly confirm may you use skill_create. Before saving, remove API keys, tokens, passwords, email addresses, and machine-specific absolute paths. If I choose a project skill and this conversation is not in that project, explain that and ask me to open the target project first.
